description: Department of Co-operative Development Central Provincial Council - The Registration has been cancelled of the Co-operative Societies in the Matale District
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the liquidation proceedings of multiple co-operative societies in the Matale District. It is a call for creditors and members to submit claims, which is a business/commercial matter related to corporate dissolutions and financial claims against businesses. This falls squarely under Commercial Gazettes (Type 6) for business and commercial regulatory matters.
